newsitem.title: USA: Atrix signs agreement with Block.
newsitem.headline: Atrix signs agreement with Block.

text.p: Atrix Laboratories Inc said on Tuesday that it signed an agreement with Block Drug Co, which includes potential milestone payments to Atrix in excess of $50 million over the next 3-5 years, as well as manufacturing margins and royalties on sales.
Under the terms of the deal, Block Drug would receive North American and certain European marketing rights to the first three Atrix products for the treatment of periodontal disease.
Block Drug would market and sell the products and advise, consult, and financially support various aspects of Atrix's continuing dental research and development program.
Atrix would manufacture three products in Fort Collins, Colorado, and continue research and development activities based upon its patented ATRIGEL Drug Delivery Technology.

The company said that periodontal disease, characterized by infection and inflammation of the gums and surrounding tissue, accounts for over 40 percent of the $42 billion spent annually for dental care in the U.S.
The Atrix product line includes both surgical and non-surgical approaches and may be used alone or in conjunction with conventional therapy.
